Notes: Secondary pulley target

Notes: Peaks ~3 MPa when shifting into D/R

Notes: Saturates at +127 standing in gear and -127 lifting off; ~0 when lockup is closed

Name: CVT fluid temperature
Status: Confirmed vs CVTz50 (82 C a few minutes earlier)

Name: Vehicle speed (TCM)
Status: Confirmed vs ECM 010D on a 52 min drive (r = 1.00)
Notes: Reads ~2% below the ECM speed; 1102 and 1103 are identical copies

Name: Engine coolant temp (TCM copy)
Status: Confirmed vs ECM 0105 degree for degree
Notes: Duplicate of the ECM value

Name: TCM lock-up status byte
Notes: 0 launch, 16 slipping on throttle, 32 engaging, 48 locked on throttle, 64 and up locked while coasting (pedal off)

Name: TCC solenoid current (ISOLT1)
Notes: 0 when open; jumps to ~0.35 A and ramps up while the clutch engages; ~0.42 A cruise, up to 0.70 A under load. 121E is the same signal /4

Name: Pressure solenoid currents (likely)
Notes: ~0.78-0.83 A always; matches the ISOL2 0.8 A idle spec

Name: Speed signals (rpm)
Notes: Follow engine/pulley speed

Name: Unknown (clutch pressure?)
Example raw -> value: 0 in P/N; ~15 in D/R; up to 36
Notes: Rises with rpm in gear

Name: Unknown (throttle / torque?)
Notes: Follow rpm and throttle (r ~0.75 with rpm)

Name: Unknown
Notes: Falls with speed

Name: Not used on this car
Notes: 1125 is NOT the lockup current (0 for the whole 52 min drive). The real one is 1219 (2 bytes)

Name: Supported-PID bitmaps
Example raw -> value: FF FF FB E7 / F1 E0 00 00
Notes: TCM data exists only in 221101-22112B

Name: Gear ratio (from internet table)
Notes: Gear ratio / lockup current / deterioration count are NOT in 2211xx

Name: Engine RPM (ECM)
Notes: Read every 2nd loop (RPM_EVERY)

Name: Vehicle speed (ECM)
Notes: Dashboard uses TCM 1101 instead (comes free in the multi-PID request)

Name: CVT fluid wear (deterioration counter)
Notes: Service 21 LID 03; Nissan limit 210000; read once a minute

Name: Engine RPM (ECM extended)
Notes: All 7E0 mode 22 DIDs need session 10C0 first

Name: Oil pressure sensor (EOP)
Notes: psi = (V - 0.55) * 20.7 (unconfirmed)

Name: Engine torque (CVTz50 VENG_TRQ)

Name: Selector position (bit flags)
Notes: Same information as 1119
